name: Octane
description: Persistent, provenance-aware project intelligence and investigation tools for OpenClaw.

allowedProjectRoots.description: Absolute existing directories Octane is permitted to register and inspect.

allowedDockerImages.description: Optional exact allowlist of trusted Docker images. Workspace command execution is denied unless the selected image appears here. Pin reviewed images by digest where possible.

allowAgentProvisioning.description: Explicitly permit agent creation using fixed reader, explorer, investigator, or verifier permission presets.

databasePath.description: SQLite database path; defaults under OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR/octane.

workspaceRoot.description: Disposable snapshots directory; defaults under OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR/octane/workspaces.

pythonExecutable.description: Python 3.11+ executable; defaults to python3 (python on Windows).
